verdict.rationale: Runtime probes show a keyless, downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec at askjo.ai/openapi.json with about 405 paths, plus Swagger UI at /docs, so a machine-readable spec is retrievable. However, it appears to be the internal app/bridge backend spec, with no developer program or public API keys documented around it, and none of the first-party docs present it as a supported surface. missing for 10: first-party documentation presenting the spec as a supported public API, documented public API access/keys for using the spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://askjo.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
keyless GET of https://askjo.ai/openapi.json returned the backend's OpenAPI 3.1 spec
